verdict.rationale: Superhuman Mail integrates calendar viewing in a side panel, lets users find teammate availability, add multiple calendars, and schedule across time zones without leaving the client (docs-7,19,32,44), but the evidence pack shows no explicit capability to view a full calendar UI or directly respond to/accept-decline meeting invites within the client, nor create events manually beyond scheduling via Find Time. missing for 10: direct invite RSVP handling, full calendar/event creation UI, and independent hands-on confirmation of these calendar actions.
